segments.sn9.13:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū kosalesu viharanti aññatarasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākatindriyā.
segments.sn9.13:1.2: Atha kho yā tasmiṃ vanasaṇḍe adhivatthā devatā tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anukampikā atthakāmā te bhikkhū saṃvejetukāmā yena te bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā te bhikkhū gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn9.13:2.5: Loke aniccataṃ ñatvā, dukkhassantaṃ akaṃsu te.
segments.sn9.13:4.3: Apaviddhā [apaviṭṭhā (syā. kaṃ.)] anāthā te, yathā petā tatheva te.
segments.sn9.13:5.1: “Ye kho pamattā viharanti, te me sandhāya bhāsitaṃ;
segments.sn9.13:5.3: Ye appamattā viharanti, namo tesaṃ karomahan”ti.
segments.sn9.13:6.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū tāya devatāya saṃvejitā saṃvegamāpādunti.
